_comment: Feedback notes per driver. Categories: positive, coaching, warning, general.
_format: Standard line: 'Week|Month of <range>: Score <N> (<±N>) · <min> min · ⭐<stars if any> · <infractions or clean>. <Action/observation>.'

_categories.positive: Recognition: clean week, big improvement, stars, top of leaderboard.
_categories.coaching: Pattern worth addressing: specific recurring infractions, mid-grade dips.
_categories.warning: Significant regression or severe pattern that needs immediate attention.
_categories.general: Informational: stable week, no clear positive/negative signal, context-only.
